```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

sns.set(style="whitegrid")
pairplot = sns.pairplot(data=df, hue="species", height=1.8, diag_kind="hist", 
                        markers=["o", "s", "D"], palette="Set2")
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Iris Flower Species: Feature Relationships", y=1.02)
pairplot._legend.set_title("Species")

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
